visual_plan: style: FLAT skin for the whole reel (same as Ep 0/Ep 2: one series look). Setting: the same generic office as 20 Nov (open cubicles, big wall clock, the manager's glass cabin 'MANAGER', no company name, no logos or brands). Continuity egg: a small sticky note 'SECONDARY ⭐' on Ramesh's monitor (Ep 0 callback). Freeze frames = still + white flash pop + slight desaturation, not a skin switch. Christmas decor, office-party only: paper star, a small decorated tree by the reception, red-green streamers, a 'MERRY CHRISTMAS' banner (no religious imagery, no church/nativity). Pantry: kettle, tea cups, a whiteboard.

CAST (same in every frame of Ep 1 and Ep 2, and the same as Ep 0 '10 nimishala late', 20 Nov): RAMESH = RAMESH_OPT from tools/anim2d/cast.md (light-blue untucked shirt, messy hair, light stubble, badge 'RAMESH · STAFF'; his helmet on his desk); MANAGER = MANAGER_OPT (tucked white shirt, maroon tie, thick moustache, bald top + grey temples, paunch, the plain white mug in his LEFT hand). NEW SURESH (not the 15 Nov TL): oiled, shiny side-parted hair with a comb line, a too-tight pale-lavender formal shirt buttoned to the collar with straining buttons, no tie, a small notepad, badge 'SURESH · STAFF', always nodding (bobble nod loop). NEW PRIYA: high ponytail, mustard-yellow top under a navy cardigan, small gold hoops, a pen behind her ear, a clipboard when she hosts the games, badge 'PRIYA · STAFF'. EXTRAS (silent / chorus only): the 20 Nov colleagues — pink-kurta woman with a bun, green-shirt man with glasses, orange-shirt man with a moustache. Gopi: corner cut-out for his lines only.

Intro 0.0-0.8 s (no voice): text hook '🎄 Operation Red Flower 🌺' big from frame 1. Villain entry: the cabin door blasts open, the manager walks out in slow-mo, mug steam drifting like smoke, low camera angle.
L1 hook: DHOOM punch-in on 'Attention'; jingle sparkle + tinsel on 'Christmas games!'; on 'కానీ…' the record scratch, the decorations seem to droop; chip 'PENDING WORK ✅ FIRST'.
L2: Ramesh with a sweet innocent smile, hands folded; colleagues snicker behind the cubicles. Whip to the pantry.

L3-L4 (secret pantry meeting): low warm light, the team huddled round the kettle; Priya draws on the whiteboard: '🎯 TARGET: MANAGER'. On 'Operation Red Flower!' a heist-style title card 'OPERATION RED FLOWER 🌺' slams in; hands-in huddle.

L5 musical chairs: a row of office chairs; the manager cracks his knuckles, struts. The tune stops, everyone dives, he lands on the floor between two chairs; FAAAH #1 with a freeze-zoom on his face and a flat red burst.
L6: Ramesh offers a hand, too sweet; chip 'IMPORTANT CHAIR 💺 = MANAGER'; laugh track.
L7 follow: FOLLOW button pops by Gopi's corner cut-out and gets tapped.
L8-L10 Truth or Dare: a bottle spins on the pantry table and stops on the manager; Priya with her clipboard. On 'సురేష్!' a spotlight hits Suresh, who nods like a bobble-head; sparkle around him.
L11: Ramesh polite and slow; two chips: the team in a long 'APPRAISAL QUEUE' line vs Suresh with a gold 'VIP PASS' lanyard; 'ooooh', then the TV-serial triple zoom on the manager.

L12 award: drumroll; a huge bright-red flower garland (felicitation style, bright red, NOT a white/funeral garland) drops round his neck and a Santa hat lands on his bald head; FAAAH #2. Optional owner-approved extra: Priya tucks one small red flower behind his ear (the Telugu 'చెవిలో పువ్వు' = 'fooled you' nod), silent.
L13: an award plaque STAMPS in: 'BEST MANAGER 2026 🏆 — సంవత్సరమంతా మమ్మల్ని పరిగెత్తించినందుకు 🏃'; laugh + applause.
L14: the manager roars, garland swinging, hat askew; chip 'WORKLOAD ×2'; lights flicker on the DHOOM; then silence.

L15 punch: Ramesh turns to the camera (close-up, the team blurred behind); a little Santa-sack icon full of laptops/files on 'పనులు గిఫ్ట్‌గా'; DONK on the manager's blank face (st.blank + st.twitch).

L16 FREEZE: the whole team waves 'Merry Christmas Sir!' with party poppers; FREEZE FRAME on the group + the manager in garland and Santa hat, a white flash, text 'MERRY CHRISTMAS SIR! 😂' over the still; comedy sting.
L17 comment: bubbles 'మీ manager కి ఏ award? 👇' (example bubbles '😂😂', 'Best Running Coach award', no real usernames).
